title: frames.json of a Math Canvas bundle (and the frames of a project file)
description: The marked regions of a PDF. Coordinates are fractions of the page as displayed (after /Rotate), origin top-left. This schema checks shapes and ranges; the tools also check what a schema cannot say: every rect at least 0.02 wide and 0.01 tall, pages inside the document, and the parts of one unit tiling one area per page (see docs/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md). It is stricter than the reader on purpose: it flags unknown fields so that typos are caught.

page.description: Zero-based page of the main region.

continues.description: Further regions of the same task, in reading order. Not allowed together with unit.

unit.description: Frames that share a unit are the parts of one exercise. Only exercises.

context.description: Instruction, question or background that belongs to this exercise, wherever it is printed. Only exercises.
